errorCodes.meaning: No delegation for this key exists that the caller may revoke. Returned identically for a key that was never enrolled and for one belonging to an identity the caller has no authority over, so the code cannot be used to probe which keys are enrolled for whom.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

remainingActive.description: How many of the owning identity's delegations are still active. Zero is a legitimate state: losing every delegated key costs an identity the delegated signing path, not its own standing or its other credentials.

revokedAt.description: When the delegation was revoked. For a delegation that was already revoked, the original instant: a revoke of a revoked key succeeds and changes nothing.

Response.title: Auth — Signing Key Revoke — response payload

SigningKeyDid.description: The delegated key, as a `did:key` — an Ed25519 multikey (`z6Mk…`) derived from the public half of a keypair the holder generated for itself, typically a non-extractable browser key. `did:key` only, because its document is a function of the key and resolves with no network: a key whose DID document could be rewritten after enrolment is not the key that was enrolled.

schema.description: Revoke one signing-key delegation, by its key. The next document the key signs is refused. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.
